query:
Consider the sector below. 

Calculate the perimeter of the sector. Round your answer to two decimal places.
subject: PlaneGeometry

provenance.previous_model_response:
The sector has radius \(r=32.2\text{ m}\) and central angle \(340^\circ\).

The perimeter includes two radii and the major arc:

\[
P=2r+\frac{340}{360}(2\pi r)
\]

\[
P=2(32.2)+\frac{340}{360}(2\pi\cdot32.2)
=255.4786\text{ m}
\]

Rounded to two decimal places:

\[
\boxed{255.48\text{ m}}
\]
